transform.prompt: Make this email short and clear. Bullets, with the ask first.

before.title: Nobody reads *all of this*
before.subject: Quick update on the project (sorry, long one!)
body: I just wanted to reach out and give everyone a quick update on where things are with the website project, since I know there have been a lot of questions going around and I wanted to make sure we're all on the same page before the end of the week.

So, as some of you might already know, the designer sent over the new homepage files yesterday afternoon, and I've had a chance to look through them, and overall I think they look really good, although there are a couple of small things we might want to tweak at some point.

Also, I talked to Mark about the launch date, and it sounds like we may need to push it back a little, probably to the 18th instead of the 11th, but that's not 100% confirmed yet, so please don't share it outside the team just yet.
One more thing: could everyone please send me their feedback on the homepage by Wednesday if possible? That would really help me pull everything together in time.
Thanks so much, and let me know if you have any questions at all!

after.title: Same email, *80% shorter*
after.subject: Website: feedback by Wed + launch update
lines: Hi team, one ask and two updates:
==• Please send homepage feedback by Wednesday.==
• New homepage designs are in. They look good.
• Launch likely moves to **the 18th** (not confirmed yet, keep it in the team).
